title: Fail-closed recovery after interrupted native Windows Backup Broker SCM registration

phases.objective: Correct virtual Windows service account registration and recover only exact attested inert SCM install residue without DBA or Production authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Invoke native installer with a virtual service account and inspect recovery-plan/negative authorization contract.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Empty native password argument is omitted, recovery requires exact copied binary, directory ACL and explicit owner-scoped elevated operator; non-admin apply fails closed without SCM writes.
steps: Verify Windows PowerShell 5.1 drops an empty password argument and omit password= entirely from sc.exe virtual-account registration.
Report only sanitized sc.exe exit and Win32 error codes on failed registration.
Require an explicit ResumeInterruptedRegistration switch and exact previously copied executable SHA-256, single file, no reparse point, protected SYSTEM/Administrators ACL.
Re-check pinned repository, remote main, deployed/certified source, in-container manifest, binary digest and Windows elevation before any service registration.
Reject unprivileged attempts before filesystem or SCM changes, and keep all DBA/backup/restore and Production mutation paths blocked.
assertions: PowerShell native sc.exe command never passes the empty password= option and captures native failure codes.
Partial-install recovery rejects unknown content, hash mismatch, unprotected ACL and missing explicit flag.
Negative non-elevated path rejects with BROKER_WINDOWS_ADMINISTRATOR_REQUIRED before SCM registration.
Host binary is inert and creates no SQL/DB, network, private key or Production mutation surface.
